description: Archery covers range safety, arrows and equipment, how archery is scored, and — under qualified supervision — shooting form and qualifying scores with a recurve, longbow or compound bow.

safety.note: Archery is done only on an approved range under a certified range supervisor, following the National Range and Target Activities Manual.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. Requirement 5 offers a recurve or longbow option and a compound bow option, each with its own steps and qualifying scores.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)
National Range and Target Activities Manual, 2026 (scouting.org)

requirements.title: Range safety
requirements.summary: Projectile risks, range rules and whistle commands, safe arrow retrieval and archery laws.

requirements.title: Arrows
requirements.summary: Arrow parts, types and materials, making or repairing an arrow, and arrow care.

requirements.title: Archery gear
requirements.summary: Tabs, arm guards, gloves and quivers, and terms such as draw length and draw weight.

requirements.title: Archery concepts
requirements.summary: Ends and rounds, field, target and 3-D archery, and scoring a target.

requirements.title: Shooting
requirements.summary: Under qualified supervision, one bow option: bow parts and care, shooting form and a qualifying score.
